blocks.html: And nevertheless, on the morrow, early in the morning, the said Pierre Guerre, joint attorney of the said de Rols, accompanied by his sons-in-law, all armed, had him made prisoner, although at that time there could be no new charges, and the said de Rols had not yet made the said Pierre Guerre her attorney to those ends: for the procuration [the power of attorney] was not made that day until the evening after vespers, as this same Pierre Guerre has himself since confessed.
